title: Member invite result (CR-13, POST /members/invite)
description: What inviting a person into the pinned organization did. `invited` (201): a new invitation was issued and emailed. `pending` (200): an invitation for that email was still pending and is answered again; nothing is sent twice. `already_member` (200): the person is a member (the tenant owner is a member of every organization). `added` (201): the person already belonged to the tenant and joined this roster directly, with no email (records organization.member.added). The invitation token never appears here: it exists only inside the email.

userId.description: The member's user id (`already_member`, `added`), else null. The member DTO itself comes from GET /members and organization.member.* events.
